title: First Choir Lock: Threshold Sign
description: First Choir Lock unfolds across choir vault ascent with bone-white arches, bells, and sanctified stairs, pushing a 5-Titan Empyrean Titan to prove protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, battle lineless aura play. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: First Choir Lock: Threshold Sign advances Empyrean Choir Vault: The Radiant Hierarchies ascend a broken heaven-engine where order can stabilize worlds or erase dissonant survivors. It directly tests the faction tension: Their mercy is real, but so is their judgment. Allies fear becoming evidence in an Empyrean trial.
terrain: choir vault ascent with bone-white arches, bells, and sanctified stairs

objectives.primary: Secure the The Choir-Axiom Gate approach before Hollow pressure rewrites the field.
optional: Keep at least four Titans standing
Trigger at least two Empyrean faction mechanics

reinforcement from the Gate wound flank

specialRules: Choir Lock: beacon timing shields battle line if objectives resolve in order.
